prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1138; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a main road in Pearland, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped at a red light in the right lane.
Q: What happened next?
A: I was waiting for the light to change when I felt a hard jolt from behind. The other car hit my rear bumper. I didn't see it coming because I was looking at the signal.
Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle afterward?
A: Yes, it was drivable, but the trunk wouldn't close properly and the bumper was pushed in. I pulled into the parking lot and waited for the police.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. My neck was stiff and sore, and my lower back felt tight, especially when I sat for long periods.
Q: Have you been seeing a doctor since then?
A: Yes, I'm going to physical therapy twice a week. The doctor diagnosed me with a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I've been out for a few days and I'm on light duties now. I'm still having trouble lifting things at home.
Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness before this collision?
A: I had some occasional back stiffness, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing my normal activities.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still recovering, and I'd appreciate it if you kept me updated on the claim.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
